  [1] File: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (line ~1030)
      Problem: Unquoted command substitution for mktemp. The assignments `POST_OUT=$(mktemp 2>/dev/null)` and `POST_ERR=$(mktemp 2>/dev/null)` lack quotes around the command substitution, making them vulnerable to word splitting if the mktemp output contains whitespace. This is inconsistent with other mktemp usages in the same file (lines 827, 859, 1655) which correctly use `"$(mktemp)"`.; Bash performs word splitting on unquoted command substitution results. If the temporary directory path contains spaces (possible with custom runner configurations), the assignment would store only the first word. All subsequent operations using POST_OUT/POST_ERR (redirects, cat/head, rm) would then fail with "No such file or directory", breaking the diagnostic capture this PR aims to provide and potentially leaving temp files orphaned on partial failure paths.; HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS:
